playstyle: Heavy-hitting rushdown through four stances. Use plus-on-block moves and stance transitions (RFF, LFS, RFS) to keep a torrent of pressure going and make sidestepping hard. Wavu warns his stances take time to learn, and almost every attack is a punch or kick, so parries and power crushes can hurt him.

stances.name: Right Foot Forward
stances.entry: 3+4, and many moves transition to it (f+2, df+4, f,F+3)
stances.note: RFF.2,3 is an i10 wall-splat punish (Wavu); RFF.3~4 is a homing power crush; RFF.df+3 is a Heat Engager.

stances.name: Left Flamingo Stance
stances.note: LFS.f+3 is a Heat Engager and +4 on block; LFS.uf+4 tornadoes.

stances.name: Right Flamingo Stance
stances.note: RFS.b+3 is a Heat Engager; RFS.uf+4 tornadoes. In Heat, several RFS strings become natural combos (Wavu).

stances.name: Left Foot Forward
stances.note: The standing stance most of his moves come from.

keyMoves: Right Jab: i10, +0 on block, can transition to LFS with 3.
His jab goes into stance pressure.
i10 jab string, the start of his i10 punishes (Wavu lists 1,2,3 and 1,2,4).
i13 mid, -1 on block (also from RFF).
Rusty Knife: i16 mid, -2 on block, transitions to RFF.
A safe mid into stance pressure.
Right Hook Kick: i17 high, +7 to +13 on block.
A very plus high that keeps the turn.
A key pressure tool: mix it with mids.
Right Uppercut: i15 launcher, -7 on block.
His i15 launch punisher, safe on block.
Against crouchers: only +4s on normal hit.
Duck it if they spam it.
Chonsan Spin: while-standing tornado string, +3 on block.
Iron Heel: i14 while-standing mid, -12 on block.
Firecracker: i20 low into a high that tornadoes, -13 on block.
A low with a launch follow-up.
Block low, duck the second hit.
Sweep Kick: i19 low, -13 on block.
Peacekeeper: i17 mid Heat Engager, -7 on block.
Sky Rocket: i16 tornado from a crouch dash. The just-frame version is -8 on block.
Pickpocket: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2.

combos.name: Launch BnB: f+4~RFS.3~4 d+4,4 T! uf+3,4,3
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as df+2.
mistakes: Not cancelling f+4 into RFS quickly enough.
Doing d+4,4 too slowly after the stance kick.
